name: Kråkboet
description: Cramped, candlelit dive bar on Södermalm with sticky floors, a punk jukebox and the cheapest lager south of Slussen. Gets rowdy after 11.

name: Glasögat
description: Polished cocktail lounge in Östermalm with velvet booths, a bow-tied bartender and a menu of stirred classics. Dress up a bit or feel underdressed.

name: Sillstrumpan
description: Old-school pub in Gamla Stan serving herring plates, aquavit flights and Swedish lager under low vaulted ceilings. Touristy but honest.

name: Hamnkranen
description: Waterfront beer garden in Hammarby Sjöstad with long picnic tables, rotating local IPAs and sunset views over the canal. Summer only.

name: Mörka Rummet
description: Speakeasy hidden behind an unmarked door in Vasastan. No sign, no standing, reservations essential. Smoky mezcal drinks and jazz on vinyl.

name: Bulldoggen
description: British-style football pub near Odenplan showing Premier League matches on six screens. Pints, pies and shouting. Packed on weekends.

name: Tant Gröns Bar
description: Quirky natural wine bar in SoFo decorated like a grandmother's living room, with doilies, houseplants and funky orange wines by the glass.

name: Ankarlänken
description: Floating bar on an old boat moored at Söder Mälarstrand. Gently rocking deck, cheap spritzes and a young after-work crowd.

name: Pannrummet
description: Industrial craft beer hall in a former boiler room on Kungsholmen with 30 taps, brewery tours and a menu of smoked meats.

name: Snödroppen
description: Tiny après-ski themed bar near Medborgarplatsen with fondue, schlager hits and staff in ski jackets all year round. Gloriously silly.

name: Lilla Hörnan
description: Neighbourhood corner bar in Midsommarkransen where locals bring their dogs. Board games, a fireplace and a short list of Swedish ciders.

name: Takterrassen
description: Rooftop bar on top of a hotel in Norrmalm with panoramic views of the city, heaters for chilly evenings and pricey champagne cocktails.

name: Rävgrytan
description: Underground rock club in Hornstull with live bands most nights, a mosh pit and cans of beer served from a fridge behind the stage.

name: Kafé Kometen
description: Daytime café that turns into a queer-friendly dance bar after 10 on Fridays, with disco DJs and glitter on the floor by midnight.

name: Gubbröra
description: Retro 1970s bar in Aspudden with brown wood panelling, a pool table and pensioners who've been drinking here since it opened.

name: Fjällstugan
description: Cosy log-cabin style bar in Vasastan with reindeer skins on the benches, mulled wine in winter and whisky from northern Sweden.

name: Neonhjärtat
description: Arcade bar in Södermalm stacked with vintage pinball machines and Street Fighter cabinets. Tokens with every drink, nerdy and loud.

name: Strömkarlen
description: Elegant hotel bar overlooking Strömmen with a grand piano, crystal chandeliers and martinis served at exactly the right temperature.

name: Bryggeriet Söder
description: Brewpub making its own sour beers and stouts on site in SoFo. Tasting paddles, beer geeks and long discussions about hops.

name: Krogen Kålen
description: Classic Swedish krog in Östermalm with a dark wood bar, schnapps songs on Thursdays and meatballs that sell out by 8.

name: Vinkällaren Bacchus
description: Candlelit wine cellar in Gamla Stan with stone walls, 400 bottles on the list and a sommelier who will happily lecture you.

name: Pumpen
description: No-frills student bar near KTH with cheap pitchers, beer pong tables and a quiz night that gets surprisingly competitive.

name: Sjöboden
description: Seasonal seafood shack bar on Djurgården serving shrimp sandwiches, rosé and cold beer on a wooden jetty by the water.

name: Glitterboxen
description: Karaoke bar in Norrmalm with private booths, a 10,000-song catalogue and themed nights from ABBA to K-pop. Best after a few drinks.

name: Ugglan
description: Quiet bookish bar in Vasastan with floor-to-ceiling shelves, armchairs and a strict no-loud-voices rule. Excellent single malts.

name: Kvarnen Lilla
description: Busy beer hall near Medborgarplatsen with high ceilings, Hammarby football fans and a buzzing crowd every night of the week.

name: Tequila Tjuren
description: Loud Mexican-themed cantina in Södermalm with frozen margaritas, taco Tuesdays and a mechanical bull nobody should ride.

name: Mysbaren
description: Hygge-heavy wine bar in Kungsholmen with sheepskin throws, candles everywhere and a cheese board big enough for four.

name: Rostfritt
description: Minimalist cocktail bar in SoFo with a stainless steel counter, house-made bitters and experimental drinks using Nordic herbs.

name: Spårvagnen
description: Bar built inside a decommissioned tram carriage in Hammarby, serving cheap beer and toasties to commuters and late-night stragglers.

name: Ölstugan Norr
description: Traditional beer pub in Vasastan with 20 Belgian beers on draft, wooden booths and staff who know their trappists.

name: Klubb Mörker
description: Techno basement club near Slussen that opens at midnight and closes at dawn. Strict door, phone cameras taped over, serious sound system.

name: Fiskmåsen
description: Breezy terrace bar on Långholmen with views over Riddarfjärden, aperol spritzes and a crowd of sunburnt locals in summer.

name: Pärlan
description: Art deco piano bar in Östermalm with live jazz on weekends, champagne by the glass and an older, well-heeled crowd.

name: Sotarn
description: Grimy but beloved rock bar in Hornstull with heavy metal on the speakers, cheap shots and a bartender called Mange who knows everyone.

name: Blå Dörren
description: Low-key wine bar in Gamla Stan behind a blue door. Small plates, natural wines and a cellar room you can book for groups.

name: Huset Vid Sjön
description: Lakeside bar near Hammarby Sjö with a sauna you can rent, cold-water dips off the pier and beer afterwards. Very Swedish.

name: Gin Fabriken
description: Gin bar in Norrmalm with over 150 gins, tonic flights and a tasting menu that walks you through Swedish distilleries.

name: Lådan
description: Shipping-container pop-up bar near Telefonplan with street food trucks, DJ sets and cheap tinnies. Opens May to September.

name: Hemma Hos
description: Living-room style bar in Aspudden where you sit on mismatched sofas and the playlist is chosen by whoever's behind the bar that night.

name: Ångbåten
description: Historic steamboat bar at Strandvägen with polished brass, sea shanties on Fridays and a captain's punch that knocks you sideways.

name: Pubben på Hörnet
description: Irish pub in Kungsholmen with Guinness on tap, live trad music on Sundays and a quiz night that's been running for 20 years.

name: Sake Stugan
description: Japanese izakaya bar in Södermalm with sake flights, highballs, yakitori and paper lanterns. Small and always full.

name: Cirkus Baren
description: Circus-themed bar near Djurgården with acrobats on weekends, striped tents over the tables and colourful, very sweet cocktails.

name: Mellanmjölk
description: Hip coffee bar by day and natural wine bar by night in SoFo. Tote bags, oat milk and a DJ who only plays Swedish 80s pop.

name: Bastun
description: Sauna bar on a floating platform in Liljeholmen. Book a session, then drink cider in your towel watching the water.

name: Gamla Grisen
description: Rustic pork-focused bar in Vasastan serving local beer and pulled pork sandwiches. Wooden benches, sawdust vibe, big portions.

name: Kolibri
description: Tiny tropical tiki bar near Mariatorget with rum-heavy drinks in ceramic mugs, flaming bowls and kitschy bamboo walls.

name: Stammis
description: Unpretentious local bar in Gärdet where the regulars outnumber newcomers ten to one. Cheap beer, darts, and a friendly welcome.

name: Ljusgården
description: Bright atrium bar in a converted greenhouse in Hammarby with hanging plants, botanical cocktails and Sunday brunch.

name: Tjuvjakt
description: Moody cocktail bar in Östermalm with a hunting-lodge theme, antler chandeliers and drinks built around game-bird infusions.

name: Vargtimmen
description: Late-night bar near Slussen that only gets going after 1am. Dim lights, cheap whisky and the last stop for night owls.

name: Örtagården
description: Herb-forward cocktail bar in Kungsholmen growing its own mint, basil and thyme on the windowsills. Fresh, green and seasonal.

name: Kompaniet
description: Large after-work bar near Stureplan full of finance types in suits on Thursdays. Good happy hour, terrible acoustics.

name: Mjölnaren
description: Mill-themed brewpub in Södermalm with a wheat beer focus, pretzels and a garden courtyard that's lovely in summer.

name: Stjärnfall
description: Rooftop stargazing bar in Vasastan with telescopes, astronomy nights and cocktails named after constellations.

name: Brunnen
description: Cellar bar built around an old well in Gamla Stan. Stone arches, flickering lanterns and medieval-inspired mead on the menu.

name: Hörnstenen
description: Sports bar in Solna near the national arena that fills up before every match. Shirts, scarves and very loud anthems.

name: Dimman
description: Fog-machine-filled goth bar in Hornstull with dark wave DJs, black lipstick, absinthe and a cracking Sunday horror film night.

name: Saltkaret
description: Seafood and cocktail bar near Nybroviken serving oysters, martinis and smoked salmon toast to an elegant evening crowd.

name: Pinglan
description: Cheesy party bar near Stureplan with bottle service, dance tables and a long queue on Saturdays. Expensive, loud and very shiny.

name: Vinden
description: Wind-swept seaside bar on Fjäderholmarna reached by ferry. Fish soup, cold beer and the archipelago stretching in every direction.

name: Kvartersbaren
description: Friendly local bar in Västertorp with sports on mute, a pinball machine and homemade toast with every second drink.

name: Röda Rummet
description: Burlesque cabaret bar in Södermalm with red velvet curtains, weekend shows and a drag brunch that sells out weeks ahead.

name: Torget
description: Square-side terrace bar at Mariatorget with people-watching, cheap rosé and the best sunny afternoon spot on Söder.

name: Kaffeslottet
description: Old-fashioned café bar in Östermalm with marble tables, cognac with your coffee and cakes that taste like 1952.

name: Byxan
description: Tiny seven-seat cocktail bar in Vasastan run by one bartender who decides what you drink based on your mood. Cash-free, chat-heavy.

name: Lyktan
description: Lantern-lit garden bar in Rålambshovsparken area with blankets, outdoor heaters and hot toddies through autumn.

name: Bärs
description: Berry-themed cider and wine bar in Kungsholmen serving lingonberry spritz, cloudberry liqueur and fruit wines from Swedish farms.

name: Mästarn
description: Old champions' boxing bar in Södermalm with signed gloves on the walls, a punchbag in the corner and stiff, simple drinks.

name: Diskot
description: Retro roller-disco bar in Hammarby with skates for rent, a glitter ball and 70s funk till 2am. Chaotic, joyful, a bit dangerous.

name: Skären
description: Archipelago-inspired bar in Norrmalm with driftwood interiors, sea buckthorn cocktails and a menu of Swedish coastal snacks.

name: Granen
description: Christmas-themed bar open all year near Odenplan with fairy lights, glögg on tap and julmust cocktails. Absurd in July.

name: Valvet
description: Bank vault turned cocktail bar in Norrmalm with the original steel door, safety deposit box menus and high-roller prices.

name: Skomakarn
description: Former shoemaker's workshop in Gamla Stan turned wine bar with leather-scented interiors and a strong Burgundy list.

name: Bölja
description: Surf-themed beach bar at Smedsuddsbadet with sand underfoot, frozen drinks and volleyball nets. Very busy on hot days.

name: Pressbyrån Baren
description: Ironic convenience-store-themed bar in SoFo serving drinks in slushie cups and hot dogs at the bar. Kitsch and fun.

name: Örnnästet
description: Penthouse bar at the top of a Kungsholmen high-rise with floor-to-ceiling windows, sunset cocktails and a strict dress code.

name: Smultronstället
description: Hidden garden bar in a Södermalm courtyard with fruit trees, homemade lemonade cocktails and a calm, local crowd.

name: Kanalen
description: Canal-side bar in Hammarby Sjöstad where you can moor your kayak and order beer and fries from the water.

name: Fyrtornet
description: Lighthouse-themed bar in Liljeholmen with nautical décor, rum flights and a rotating beacon over the bar every hour.

name: Lekstugan
description: Board-game bar in Vasastan with 500 games, game-masters on hand to teach rules and craft sodas for non-drinkers.

name: Kalaset
description: Party-planning bar in Norrmalm with set-price group packages, birthday cakes and confetti cannons on request.

name: Svampen
description: Mushroom-themed natural wine bar in SoFo with foraged snacks, earthy reds and a menu that changes with the forest.

name: Hallonbaren
description: Pink-painted dessert bar in Östermalm specialising in raspberry cocktails, sweet wines and enormous meringues.

name: Slottsbacken
description: Upmarket cocktail bar steps from the Royal Palace with a terrace over the water and drinks served with silver tongs.

name: Nattugglan
description: Cosy late-opening bar in Gärdet open until 3am on weekdays, with a reading lamp at every table and quiet electronic music.

name: Smedjan
description: Blacksmith's forge converted into a bar in Hornstull with an open fire, hot cider and whisky warmed in iron pots.

name: Klippan
description: Clifftop bar at Skinnarviksberget with the best view in town, plastic cups and a crowd of picnickers who bring their own snacks.

name: Stationen
description: Old railway station bar in Älvsjö with platform benches, departure boards listing cocktails and cheap pints for commuters.

name: Lunden
description: Leafy beer garden in Vasaparken with communal tables, sausages on the grill and a busy family crowd on Sunday afternoons.

name: Kronan
description: Crown-themed royalist bar in Gamla Stan with portraits of every Swedish monarch, gold-rimmed glasses and a royal punch.

name: Taverna Medusa
description: Greek taverna bar on Södermalm with ouzo, meze and plate-smashing on Saturdays. Loud, warm and endlessly hospitable.

name: Silverspegeln
description: Mirror-lined cocktail bar in Östermalm with a 1920s Paris vibe, absinthe service and a pianist on Thursdays.

name: Uthuset
description: Shed bar in a Midsommarkransen backyard with homemade beer, a ping-pong table and an extremely relaxed opening policy.

name: Vågbrytaren
description: Breakwater bar at the end of a pier in Nacka Strand, reached by ferry from Slussen. Sea views, cold beer and fish and chips.

name: Myrstacken
description: Busy, crowded bar near Medborgarplatsen famous for being impossible to find a seat in. Fun if you like elbows.

name: Kryddhyllan
description: Spice-cabinet themed cocktail bar in Kungsholmen with cardamom, saffron and chilli infusions in every drink.

name: Barnhemmet
description: Grungy indie bar in Hornstull with live acoustic nights, cheap beer and a staff that seems to be in every band in town.

name: Ljungen
description: Heather-filled terrace bar in Djurgården with Nordic gin, wildflower cocktails and the forest right on your doorstep.
